modeling.tariff_channel: Shell Recharge direct when explicitly evidenced; otherwise existing Morocco tariff policy applies independently

evidence.finding: Shell Al Jazira is described as the first fast EV charging infrastructure under the Shell brand in Vivo Energy's African network and the launch site for Shell Recharge at Vivo Energy Maroc.
Current Shell Maroc station page explicitly lists Shell Recharge fast charging at Al Jazira.
No later official Morocco source was found announcing a second Shell Recharge site. This is negative evidence only and must not be treated as proof that no unannounced site exists.

interpretation.production_scope: Al Jazira is the only Shell Recharge Morocco site currently supported by explicit official public evidence in this repository.
interpretation.confidence: high for Al Jazira; medium for one-site current network scope
interpretation.do_not_overclaim: Do not state that Morocco definitively has only one Shell Recharge site. State that Al Jazira is the only officially evidenced site found as of the checked date.
interpretation.impact: The previous 'national catalogue incomplete' blocker can be narrowed: no additional officially evidenced Shell Recharge Morocco locations are currently known, so Al Jazira can serve as the complete evidenced production set pending contrary evidence.
